justification: Extends the deterministic page proof (#1316): a span printed on several pages is proven on_page when the row's own stored page (pdf_page or a page_range member) is one of them, with every page listed in evidence.all_pages. If the stored page is not among them the row stays unresolved and no page is picked. Matcher, planner and verifier only; the planner is read-only on the database, apply is a dry run, nothing is written to production.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_page_evidence.py -q && python scripts/verify_page_evidence.py data/page_evidence_2026-10-18.jsonl --db
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A multi-page span is proven on a page the row does not point at, all_pages is not the full list of pages the span is printed on, or the verifier accepts an edited all_pages.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: The chapter PDFs, pinned by sha256 and re-read by PyMuPDF in the verifier, and the live provision_text md5 of each row.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Mutations run on this branch 2026-10-17: ignoring the stored page in prove() -> 5 failed; always unresolved for multi-page -> 3 failed; all_pages cut to the one page -> 2 failed; verifier not comparing all_pages -> 1 failed; verifier not requiring on_page for an ambiguous span -> 1 failed. Restored: 22 passed.

pre_impl.existing_data: page_evidence.py prove() returned unresolved for any span on 2+ pages; 64 of the 183 rows still unproven after #1316 were unresolved.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed most unresolved rows would have their stored page among the rival pages. Measured: 21 of 64 do (8 after the v3 sentence rule); ku_ring_gai (35 unresolved) mostly does not, so it stays unresolved.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Same module, new optional argument held; older evidence without all_pages still verifies by the old one-page rule (100/100 of the 2026-10-17 file re-verified).

functions.name: prove
functions.input: the rule's normalised words, every page's readings, and the pages the row already points at
functions.output: (proven, evidence with all_pages and matcher_version, info); on several pages proven only on a held page, else unresolved
functions.if_none: held=None behaves as the old rule: several pages -> unresolved

functions.name: check_uniqueness
functions.input: one evidence dict, the row's old page fields, the verdict, and all pages of the pinned PDF
functions.output: a list of problems; empty only when all_pages is re-derived exactly and an ambiguous span is on_page on a held page
functions.if_none: evidence without all_pages is checked by the old exactly-one-page rule

values.value: 8 newly proven (all on_page) after the v3 sentence rule: city_of_sydney 4, penrith 2, leichhardt 1, canterbury_bankstown 1. The v2 rule's other 13 were labels or repeated table cells.

queries.scope: regulatory_provisions joined to dcp_chapter_registry on the active row
queries.filters: is_current, v2_is_actionable, is_active; read-only session; 30s statement timeout
queries.purpose: List served council DCP rows DQ-145 counts as unproven with their chapter PDF path.
queries.where_clause: rp.is_current AND rp.v2_is_actionable AND source_council IS NOT NULL AND source_council <> 'inner_west_lep' AND NOT (citation_status IN ('proven','imprecise') OR page_check IN ('on_page','moved'))

break_it.scenario: The span is printed on several pages and the row points at none of them.
break_it.what_happens: Row stays unresolved; no page is picked.
break_it.how: prove() takes a page only from the held set; test_several_pages_stored_page_not_among_them_is_unresolved fails if that is removed.

break_it.scenario: all_pages in the evidence is edited (page dropped, page added).
break_it.what_happens: The verifier re-derives the list from the PDF and fails.
break_it.how: check_uniqueness compares the recorded list to the re-derived one.

break_it.scenario: A genuinely moved row (single page, not the stored one) carries all_pages.
break_it.what_happens: Still accepted as moved; an ambiguous span can never be moved.
break_it.how: test_verifier_accepts_single_page_move_with_all_pages and the moved check in check_uniqueness.

mutation_analysis: Five mutations killed (listed above). Two redundant verifier guards (stored page in held, evidence page in all_pages) were removed as unreachable: prove() with held already fails in both cases, so mutating them could not change behaviour.
residual_risk: Boilerplate spans (a repeated objective printed on 86 pages, a 3-word span such as 'apartments shall be' on 2 pages) are proven on the stored page: it does hold the words, but the proof does not show the page is where this particular control is stated. all_pages in the evidence makes the ambiguity visible. Nothing is applied; applying needs the user's go.

post_merge.db_reset: No. Read-only against the database; apply_page_evidence is a dry run unless --apply is passed.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run python scripts/apply_page_evidence.py data/page_evidence_2026-10-18.jsonl (dry run) and open 5 proofs' pdf pages before any --apply.
